::: {.conf-sec .disc-other}
## Ecological economics

The North American ecological-economics societies (USSEE, CANSEE) both met in 2026 and meet every two years, so their next meetings are in 2028. ISEE should meet in 2027, but the host hasn't been announced. The closest North American meeting in 2027 is AERE's, which covers environmental and resource economics.

| Society | Last meeting | Next expected | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| **[USSEE](https://www.ussee.org/)** (U.S. Society for Ecological Economics) | Jun 18–21, 2026, Oberlin College | 2028 | 2026 abstracts were due Dec 15, 2025 (extended to Jan 16), so expect a call around December 2027 |
| **[CANSEE](https://cansee.ca/)** (Canadian Society for Ecological Economics) | Oct 2026, Cape Breton University | 2028 | |
| **[AERE](https://www.aere.org/summer-conference)** (Association of Environmental and Resource Economists) | Summer Conference, June 2026 | June 2027, venue not posted | Submissions accepted **Dec 1, 2026 – early/mid-January 2027**; registration opens mid-March. Mainstream environmental economics rather than ecological economics. |
| **[ISEE](https://www.isecoeco.org/events/future-events-of-the-isee)** (International Society for Ecological Economics) | Jun 24–27, 2025, Oslo (with the Degrowth conference) | 2027? | A biennial pattern points to 2027, but ISEE lists no upcoming events. Not necessarily in North America. |
:::

.conf-legend .lg-est { fill: #fff; stroke: #5d6a76; stroke-width: 2; }
.conf-legend .lg-disc i { display: inline-block; width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 2px; }
.conf-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: .4rem; margin: .2rem 0 .7rem; }
.chips-label { font-size: .85rem; color: var(--jo-muted); margin-right: .1rem; }
.chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .4rem; font: inherit; font-size: .85rem; padding: .25rem .7rem; border-radius: 999px;
  border: 1px solid var(--jo-rule); background: #fff; color: var(--jo-muted); cursor: pointer; text-transform: none; letter-spacing: normal; }
.chip i { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; display: inline-block; opacity: .35; }
.chip[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: #9aa6b0; color: #1d2733; background: #f4f7f9; font-weight: 500; }
.chip[aria-pressed="true"] i { opacity: 1; }
.chip:focus-visible, .chip-all:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--jo-mark); outline-offset: 2px; }
.chip-all { font: inherit; font-size: .8rem; background: none; border: 0; color: var(--jo-mark); text-decoration: underline; cursor: pointer; padding: .25rem .3rem; text-transform: none; letter-spacing: normal; }
.conf-sec.is-hidden { display: none; }
.conf-filter { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: .2rem .5rem; font-size: .9rem; font-weight: 500; margin: .2rem 0 .6rem; cursor: pointer; }
.conf-filter input { width: 1.05rem; height: 1.05rem; accent-color: var(--jo-mark); cursor: pointer; }
.conf-filter-note { flex-basis: 100%; padding-left: 1.55rem; font-weight: 400; font-size: .8rem; color: var(--jo-muted); }
.conf-scroll { max-width: calc(100vw - 32px); overflow-x: auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; border: 1px solid var(--jo-rule); border-radius: 6px; background: #fff; }
#conf-timeline { min-width: 820px; }
#conf-timeline svg { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; font-family: inherit; }
#conf-timeline .grid { stroke: #ecebe6; }
#conf-timeline .month { fill: #5d6a76; font-size: 11px; }
#conf-timeline .year { fill: #1d2733; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; }
#conf-timeline .row-label { fill: #1d2733; font-size: 12px; }
#conf-timeline .row-link .row-label { fill: var(--jo-mark); text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: #c9d3da; }
#conf-timeline .row-link:hover .row-label, #conf-timeline .row-link:focus .row-label { text-decoration-color: currentColor; }
#conf-timeline .group-label { fill: #5d6a76; font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; }
#conf-timeline .today { stroke: #c0392b; stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-dasharray: 3 3; }
#conf-timeline .where { fill: #5d6a76; font-size: 11px; }
#conf-timeline .today-label { fill: #c0392b; font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 600; }
#conf-timeline .row-hit { fill: transparent; }
#conf-timeline .row-hit:hover { fill: #f6f5f1; }
#conf-timeline .mark { cursor: pointer; }
#conf-timeline .mark:hover .shape, #conf-timeline .mark:focus .shape { stroke: #1d2733; stroke-width: 2; }
#conf-timeline .mark:focus { outline: none; }
#conf-tip { position: fixed; z-index: 50; pointer-events: none; display: none; max-width: 260px;
  background: #1d2733; color: #fff; font-size: .8rem; line-height: 1.35; padding: .45rem .6rem; border-radius: 5px;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.18); }
#conf-tip b { display: block; }
.conf-next { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: .5rem 0 1rem; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(230px, 1fr)); gap: .6rem; }
.conf-next li { border: 1px solid var(--jo-rule); border-left: 4px solid var(--c); border-radius: 5px; padding: .5rem .7rem; font-size: .88rem; background: #fff; }
.conf-next .when { font-weight: 600; }
.conf-next .days { color: var(--jo-muted); font-size: .8rem; }
.conf-next .est { color: var(--jo-muted); font-style: italic; }
main table { font-size: .9rem; }
@media (max-width: 700px) { main table { display: block; overflow-x: auto; max-width: calc(100vw - 32px); } }
main table td:first-child { min-width: 10rem; }
.conf-sources { font-size: .8rem; color: var(--jo-muted); margin-top: 2rem; }
</style>

      { t: "conf", s: "2027-06-23", e: "2027-06-25", note: "ISA's summer meeting; submissions closed Oct 30" } ] },
    { g: "comp", name: "EISA Pan-European (IR)", url: "https://eisa-net.org/", where: "Ljubljana", ev: [
      { t: "conf", s: "2027-09-14", e: "2027-09-17", note: "Section proposals closed Nov 9; paper/panel call not yet posted" } ] },
    { g: "comp", name: "IPES", url: "https://www.internationalpoliticaleconomysociety.org/", where: "WashU, St. Louis", ev: [
      { t: "conf", s: "2027-11-05", e: "2027-11-06", note: "International Political Economy Society; call not posted (mid-April in 2024)" } ] },
    { g: "css", name: "IC2S2", url: "https://www.uvm.edu/socks/node/252", where: "Milan, Italy", ev: [
      { t: "sub", d: "2027-03-01", est: true, note: "Abstracts; Mar 3 in 2026, Feb 24 in 2025" },
      { t: "conf", s: "2027-07-20", e: "2027-07-23", est: true, note: "Late July in recent years" } ] },
    { g: "css", name: "Sunbelt (INSNA)", url: "https://www.insna.org/events/sunbelt-2027-montreal", where: "Montréal", ev: [
      { t: "sub", d: "2027-02-01", note: "Oral presentations and posters" },
      { t: "conf", s: "2027-06-21", e: "2027-06-26", est: true, note: "Workshops Jun 21–23; main-conference dates not posted" } ] },
    { g: "css", name: "PaCSS", url: "https://cssi.umass.edu/node/314", where: "With APSA, Washington", ev: [
      { t: "conf", s: "2027-09-01", e: "2027-09-01", est: true, note: "One-day APSA pre-conference in recent years (Sep 2, 2026 in Boston)" } ] },
    { g: "css", name: "TADA (Text as Data)", url: "https://www.aclweb.org/portal/content/cfp-tada-2026-new-directions-analyzing-text-data-uc-berkeley-extended-deadline", where: "Host not posted", ev: [
      { t: "sub", d: "2027-08-02", est: true, note: "One-page abstracts; early August in 2023 and 2026" },
      { t: "conf", s: "2027-10-04", e: "2027-10-05", est: true, note: "Autumn; Oct 5 at Berkeley in 2026" } ] },
  ];

  ROWS.sort((a, b) => ORDER.indexOf(a.g) - ORDER.indexOf(b.g));   // stable: keeps order within a group

  const TODAY = new Date("2026-11-11T12:00");
  const START = new Date("2026-11-01T00:00"), END = new Date("2028-01-01T00:00");
  const D = s => new Date(s + "T12:00");
  const fmt = (d, o = { month: "short", day: "numeric", year: "numeric" }) => d.toLocaleDateString("en-US", o);
  const TYPE = { conf: "Conference", sub: "Submission deadline", reg: "Registration" };

  const W = 1000, LW = 210, RH = 26, GH = 22, TOP = 40, PAD = 14;
  const x = d => LW + (d - START) / (END - START) * (W - LW - PAD);
  const ns = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
  const el = (tag, attrs, parent) => { const n = document.createElementNS(ns, tag); for (const k in attrs) n.setAttribute(k, attrs[k]); parent && parent.appendChild(n); return n; };

  const tip = document.getElementById("conf-tip");
  const show = (ev, html) => { tip.innerHTML = html; tip.style.display = "block"; move(ev); };
  const move = ev => {
    const p = ev.touches ? ev.touches[0] : ev; const r = tip.getBoundingClientRect();
    let left = p.clientX + 12, top = p.clientY + 14;
    if (left + r.width > innerWidth - 8) left = p.clientX - r.width - 12;
    if (top + r.height > innerHeight - 8) top = p.clientY - r.height - 12;
    tip.style.left = left + "px"; tip.style.top = top + "px";
  };
  const hide = () => { tip.style.display = "none"; };

  // A row is "open" when it still has a submission deadline ahead of today (posted or estimated).
  const isOpen = r => r.g !== "other" && r.ev.some(e => e.t === "sub" && e.talk !== false && D(e.d) >= TODAY);

  function draw(rows) {
  let y = TOP; const layout = []; let lastG = null;
  for (const r of rows) { if (r.g !== lastG) { layout.push({ group: r.g, y: y + 15 }); y += GH; lastG = r.g; } layout.push({ row: r, y }); y += RH; }
  const H = y + 10;
  const svg = el("svg", { viewBox: `0 0 ${W} ${H}` });

  // month grid
  // month grid
  for (let m = new Date(START); m <= END; m = new Date(m.getFullYear(), m.getMonth() + 1, 1)) {
    const xx = x(m);
    el("line", { x1: xx, x2: xx, y1: TOP - 8, y2: H - 6, class: "grid" }, svg);
    if (m < END) {
      const mid = x(new Date(m.getFullYear(), m.getMonth(), 15));
      el("text", { x: mid, y: 30, "text-anchor": "middle", class: "month" }, svg).textContent = fmt(m, { month: "short" });
      if (m.getMonth() === 0 || +m === +START) el("text", { x: xx + 3, y: 14, class: "year" }, svg).textContent = m.getFullYear();
    }
  }

  for (const L of layout) {
    if (L.group) { el("text", { x: 8, y: L.y, class: "group-label" }, svg).textContent = G[L.group][0]; continue; }
    const r = L.row, cy = L.y + RH / 2, col = G[r.g][1];
    el("rect", { x: 0, y: L.y, width: W, height: RH, class: "row-hit" }, svg);
    const lab = r.url ? el("a", { href: r.url, target: "_blank", rel: "noopener", class: "row-link" }, svg) : svg;
    el("text", { x: 14, y: cy + 4, class: "row-label" }, lab).textContent = r.name;
    for (const e of r.ev) {
      const g = el("g", { class: "mark", tabindex: 0 }, svg);
      let when, d0;
      if (e.t === "conf") {
        const s = D(e.s), en = D(e.e); d0 = s;
        const x0 = x(s) - 3, x1 = Math.max(x(en) + 3, x0 + 14);
        el("rect", { x: x0 - 6, y: cy - 10, width: x1 - x0 + 12, height: 20, fill: "transparent" }, g);
        if (!e.nolabel) {
        const right = x1 + 6 + r.where.length * 6 < W - PAD;
        el("text", { x: right ? x1 + 6 : x0 - 6, y: cy + 4, "text-anchor": right ? "start" : "end", class: "where" }, svg).textContent = r.where;
        }
        el("rect", { x: x0, y: cy - 7, width: x1 - x0, height: 14, rx: 4, class: "shape",
          fill: e.est ? "#fff" : col, stroke: col, "stroke-width": e.est ? 2 : 0, "stroke-dasharray": e.est ? "3 2" : "" }, g);
        when = `${fmt(s, { month: "short", day: "numeric" })} – ${fmt(en)}`;
      } else {
        d0 = D(e.d); const cx = x(d0);
        el("circle", { cx, cy, r: 11, fill: "transparent" }, g);
        const attrs = { class: "shape", fill: e.est ? "#fff" : col, stroke: e.est ? col : "#fff", "stroke-width": e.est ? 2 : 1.5 };
        if (e.t === "sub") el("path", { d: `M${cx} ${cy - 7} L${cx + 7} ${cy} L${cx} ${cy + 7} L${cx - 7} ${cy}Z`, ...attrs }, g);
        else el("circle", { cx, cy, r: 5.5, ...attrs }, g);
        when = fmt(d0);
      }
      const html = `<b>${r.name} · ${TYPE[e.t]}</b>${when}${e.est ? " <i>(estimate)</i>" : ""}<br>${e.note ? e.note + "<br>" : ""}${r.where}`;
      g.setAttribute("aria-label", html.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, " "));
      g.addEventListener("mouseenter", ev => show(ev, html));
      g.addEventListener("mousemove", move);
      g.addEventListener("mouseleave", hide);
      g.addEventListener("focus", () => { const b = g.getBoundingClientRect(); show({ clientX: b.right, clientY: b.bottom }, html); });
      g.addEventListener("blur", hide);
      g.addEventListener("touchstart", ev => show(ev, html), { passive: true });
    }
  }

  // today line
  const tx = x(TODAY);
  el("line", { x1: tx, x2: tx, y1: TOP - 6, y2: H - 6, class: "today" }, svg);
  el("text", { x: tx + 4, y: H - 10, class: "today-label" }, svg).textContent = "Today";

  hide();
  document.getElementById("conf-timeline").replaceChildren(svg);
  }

  const box = document.getElementById("conf-open");
  const chips = [...document.querySelectorAll(".conf-chips .chip")];
  const on = new Set(chips.map(c => c.dataset.b));
  try { const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("conf-show")); if (Array.isArray(saved)) { on.clear(); saved.forEach(b => on.add(b)); } } catch (e) {}
  const shown = r => BUCKET[r.g] === "always" || on.has(BUCKET[r.g]);

  function nextUp(rows) {
    const upcoming = [];
    for (const r of rows) for (const e of r.ev) { const d0 = D(e.t === "conf" ? e.s : e.d); if (d0 >= TODAY) upcoming.push({ d: d0, r, e }); }
    const list = document.getElementById("conf-next"); list.replaceChildren();
    upcoming.sort((a, b) => a.d - b.d).slice(0, 8).forEach(u => {
      const days = Math.round((u.d - TODAY) / 864e5);
      const li = document.createElement("li"); li.style.setProperty("--c", G[u.r.g][1]);
      li.innerHTML = `<div class="when">${fmt(u.d, { month: "short", day: "numeric", year: "numeric" })}${u.e.est ? ' <span class="est">est.</span>' : ""}</div>
        <div><b>${u.r.url ? `<a href="${u.r.url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${u.r.name}</a>` : u.r.name}</b> · ${TYPE[u.e.t].toLowerCase()}</div>
        <div class="days">${u.e.note || u.r.where} · ${days === 0 ? "today" : days === 1 ? "tomorrow" : "in " + days + " days"}</div>`;
      list.appendChild(li);
    });
  }

  function update() {
    chips.forEach(c => c.setAttribute("aria-pressed", on.has(c.dataset.b)));
    document.querySelectorAll(".conf-sec").forEach(sec => {
      const b = [...sec.classList].find(c => c.startsWith("disc-")).slice(5);
      sec.classList.toggle("is-hidden", b !== "always" && !on.has(b));
    });
    const rows = ROWS.filter(shown);
    document.getElementById("conf-open-n").textContent = rows.filter(isOpen).length;
    draw(box.checked ? rows.filter(isOpen) : rows);
    nextUp(rows);
    try { localStorage.setItem("conf-show", JSON.stringify([...on])); } catch (e) {}
  }
  chips.forEach(c => c.addEventListener("click", () => { on.has(c.dataset.b) ? on.delete(c.dataset.b) : on.add(c.dataset.b); update(); }));
  document.getElementById("chip-all").addEventListener("click", () => { chips.forEach(c => on.add(c.dataset.b)); update(); });
  box.addEventListener("change", update);
  update();
  document.addEventListener("touchstart", ev => { if (!ev.target.closest || !ev.target.closest("#conf-timeline .mark")) hide(); }, { passive: true });
})();
</script>
